page_title: VER 0-2 GEN | Verona v Genoa 15/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Vitinha (Genoa) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Tomas Suslov (Verona) takes the direct free kick from far out, but his shot flies into the stands.

86' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Aaron Martin flighted in the free kick and the ball found the head of Leo Ostigard (Genoa), whose excellent bullet header sailed into the left side of the goal. 0:2.
86' Paolo Sammarco has decided to substitute Gift Orban and he is replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
86' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) is penalised for holding. Matteo Marchetti signals a set piece.
84' Aaron Martin (Genoa) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
81' Vitinha (Genoa) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
80' The game has come to an end for Martin Frese. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Amin Sarr (Verona).
79' Daniele De Rossi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) replacing Lorenzo Colombo.
78' Junior Messias comes off the pitch to be replaced by Aaron Martin (Genoa).
76' Gift Orban (Verona) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
74' Junior Messias (Genoa) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
72' Amorim (Genoa) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

71' A lofted cross from Junior Messias (Genoa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play and Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
71' Amorim comes onto the pitch after Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
70' A bullet header by Nicolas Valentini (Verona) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the right post.
70' Verona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
69' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
69' The game is interrupted now, Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
66' A crossfield pass from Tomas Suslov (Verona) fails to find any of his teammates.
65' Substitution. Tomas Suslov (Verona) on for Abdou Harroui.
65' Victor Nelsson (Verona) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

61' 0 - 1 What a spectacular moment! Vitinha (Genoa) skips past defenders and finds some space before firing a long-range strike at goal. The fans are amazed when they see the ball go into the roof of the net. The scoreline is 0:1.
59' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Vitinha (Genoa) replaces Caleb Ekuban.
59' Substitution. Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) in, Stefano Sabelli out.
57' The free kick is taken by Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa), but ball is cleared.
54' Verona fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
54' Abdou Harroui (Verona) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee signals a corner kick to Verona.
53' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
51' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
49' Abdou Harroui (Verona) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
48' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) sends a long ball in, but Lorenzo Montipo comfortably gathers the ball.
46' Rafik Belghali (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Daniel Oyegoke.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) unleashed a promising strike from a long-distance free kick, but his effort goes high over the bar so it's going to be a goal kick.
45+2' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle after Tomas Suslov (Verona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Martin Frese (Verona) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
41' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

40' Abdou Harroui (Verona) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
38' Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
35' Martin Frese (Verona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

34' Kieron Bowie (Verona) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Verona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) was quite harsh and Matteo Marchetti didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
28' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
27' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
19' Gift Orban (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Justin Bijlow, who smothers the ball.
16' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
15' Junior Messias (Genoa) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Genoa win a corner.
14' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Genoa for a penalty. Play continues.
12' Kieron Bowie (Verona) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
10' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo is alert and denies him.
7' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
6' Today's referee Matteo Marchetti rightly decides to book Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) for his harsh tackle.
5' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
5' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Verona have a corner.
1' The first half has started.
Verona will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Matteo Marchetti.
